## Purpose

`source-gap-register.csv` extracts the source-backed coverage decisions from
the dataset explainer files. It is a guide-level audit table, not a replacement
for the variable evidence appendices.

Use this register to find where an official source supports a dataset concept
and where this pass did not find enough evidence to promote generated values,
category labels, or distributions as source-backed facts.

## Files

| File | Meaning |
|---|---|
| [`source-gap-register.csv`](source-gap-register.csv) | One row per product area in the guide-level source-backed coverage tables. |
| [`generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`](generated-variable-crosswalk.csv) | One row per generated variable with local metadata/crosswalk status. |
| [`variable-evidence-appendices/index.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/index.qmd) | Rendered per-guide variable evidence tables for every generated variable. |

## Columns

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `guide` | Dataset guide stem. |
| `product_area` | Product family or variable family reviewed. |
| `source_supports` | What the official/local research source supports. |
| `not_found_or_not_proven` | What this pass did not find or did not prove. |
| `guide_file` | Source guide containing the original decision table. |

## Use Rule

Rows in this file are evidence-gap flags. If `not_found_or_not_proven` says a
codebook, distribution, or exact source mapping was not found, do not replace
that gap with local generated values in future FPLIDA builds. Either locate the
source and update the relevant guide, or keep the generated behaviour labelled
as local implementation evidence.
